enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Superior Stability: This armor grants a + 6 deflection bonus to AC and a + 6 resistance bonus to saves for characters of True Neutral alignment.
Protection +4: Passive: +4 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.
Resistance +4: Passive: +4 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Damage Reduction 3/-: Reduces all physical damage by 3.

Adamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Light armor and shields made from adamantine grant their user damage reduction of 1/-.
Mithral: Mithral armor is one type lighter then normal. Arcane Spell Failure decreased by 10%. Maximum dexterity bonus increased by 2. Armor check penalty reduced by 3.
Suppressed Power: This psionic item is powerful, but you sense that it has not unlocked all of its secrets to you at this time.

children.tooltip: Damage Reduction 5/Epic: Reduces physical damage by 5, except from Epic aligned attacks.
Bashing: This shield does an additional 1 to 6 damage when used to shield bash.
